web.portal.schedule.emailCopy: Notice receipt email queued for delivery, not confirmed delivered.
web.portal.schedule.emailDelivered: Withdrawal email delivery confirmed by server.
web.portal.schedule.emailUnknown: Withdrawal email delivery missing, failed or uncertain.
web.portal.schedule.noMoments: Empty confirmed Moments feed on the web live visit.
web.portal.schedule.noticeLabel: Labels the exact withdrawal statement submitted and shown on its receipt.
web.portal.schedule.noticeStatement: Exact withdrawal statement displayed to the customer and submitted as the statutory notice.
web.portal.schedule.passed: An arrival estimate expired without another update.
web.portal.schedule.quiet: Live status when freshness cannot be confirmed.
web.portal.schedule.receipt: Receipt identifiers; contract and notice are references.
web.portal.schedule.receiptsUnavailable: Notice history could not be fetched.
web.portal.schedule.termsHash: Immutable contract terms hash in withdrawal receipt.
web.portal.schedule.todayVisit: Quiet linked visit capsule for a visit that falls on the current day at the site. Does not imply crew attendance.
web.portal.schedule.unavailableNotice: No withdrawal entitlement or online data.
web.portal.work.decision: Recorded quote decision, actor and site time.
web.portal.work.noActiveBookings: Customer portal Now and Active Bookings empty state.
web.portal.work.noPastBookings: Customer portal Past Bookings empty state.
web.portal.work.noQuote: Quote row on customer Job Home before a quote exists.
web.portal.work.stepCount: Accessible name for the job journey or visit day line. Index is the current step (one-based), count is total steps, and stage is a localized state.
web.portal.work.todayVisits: Now section heading for visits scheduled for later today at their sites.
web.portal.work.visit: Job journey stage or visit row.
